tools.name: order-lookup
tools.title: Look up an order
tools.description: Look up an order by its number: status, items, total, what has been refunded and what still can be, and any internal notes. Use when a customer asks about an order, and before adding a note or refunding one.

orderId.description: The order number the customer gave, e.g. A-1001

tools.name: order-add-note
tools.title: Add an internal note
tools.description: Add an internal note to an order, visible to staff only, e.g. what the customer reported or what was promised. Use when someone asks to note, log or remember something about a specific order. The customer is not told.

note.description: The note, in a sentence or two

tools.name: order-refund
tools.title: Refund an order
tools.description: Send money back to the customer for a shipped, delivered or cancelled order: the full remaining amount, or `amount` for a partial refund. Use only when the customer asks for their money back and the order qualifies. A refund can't be undone.

amount.description: How much to refund, in the order's currency. Leave it out to refund everything not yet refunded

reason.description: Why, in the customer's words, e.g. arrived broken
